import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('datagov/lottery-ny-lotto-winning-numbers-beginning-2001/files/rows.txt')

# Parse the date column
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Draw Date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
df['Year'] = df['Date'].dt.year

# Filter for years 2005-2010
years_of_interest = [2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010]
df_filtered = df[df['Year'].isin(years_of_interest)]

# Calculate BVAL for each year
# BVAL = mean(bonus) + 0.5 * std(bonus)
bval_results = {}
for year in years_of_interest:
    year_data = df_filtered[df_filtered['Year'] == year]
    bonus_mean = year_data['Bonus #'].mean()
    bonus_std = year_data['Bonus #'].std()
    bval = bonus_mean + 0.5 * bonus_std
    bval_results[year] = bval
    print(f"Year {year}: mean={bonus_mean:.4f}, std={bonus_std:.4f}, BVAL={bval:.4f}")

# Find the year with highest BVAL (earlier year in case of tie)
max_bval = max(bval_results.values())
years_with_max = [y for y, bval in bval_results.items() if bval == max_bval]
answer_year = min(years_with_max)  # Earlier year in case of tie

print(f"\nHighest BVAL: {max_bval:.4f}")
print(f"Years with highest BVAL: {years_with_max}")
print(f"Answer (earlier year): {answer_year}")
EOF
```
